node.name: dig confirms DNSSEC
node.description:
Automated check: `dig +dnssec +multi DNSKEY genericom.com @1.1.1.1`

The check queries an external resolver (Cloudflare 1.1.1.1) for the DNSKEY records of genericom.com with the DNSSEC OK (DO) bit set and the multi-line output flag enabled. A passing result requires three things to all be true in the response: (1) the answer section contains DNSKEY records, (2) the answer section contains an RRSIG record covering those DNSKEY records, and (3) the response header carries the `ad` (Authenticated Data) flag, indicating the validating resolver successfully verified the chain of trust from the root.

Last run: 2026-05-05 12:34:18 UTC. Result: PASS.

--- raw output ---

; <<>> DiG 9.18.30 <<>> +dnssec +multi DNSKEY genericom.com @1.1.1.1
;; global options: +cmd
;; Got answer:
;; ->>HEADER<<- opcode: QUERY, status: NOERROR, id: 41072
;; flags: qr rd ra ad; QUERY: 1, ANSWER: 3, AUTHORITY: 0, ADDITIONAL: 1

;; OPT PSEUDOSECTION:
; EDNS: version: 0, flags: do; udp: 1232
;; QUESTION SECTION:
;genericom.com.         IN DNSKEY

;; ANSWER SECTION:
genericom.com.       3600 IN DNSKEY 256 3 13 (
                K7gOJU5bNzDqfM7T6/X8eW3vZqI9Nl0c9qj1y6+0aH3lCJ5XwPq5n2VK
                fSRSqj9p3hXp5GqOYn3oQyx4u8aA2g==
                ) ; ZSK; alg = ECDSAP256SHA256 ; key id = 28734
genericom.com.       3600 IN DNSKEY 257 3 13 (
                mdsswUyr3DPW132mOi8V9xESWE8jTo0dxCjjnopKl+GqJxpVXckHAeF+
                KkxLbxILfDLUT0rAK9iUzy1L53eKGQ==
                ) ; KSK; alg = ECDSAP256SHA256 ; key id = 19036
genericom.com.       3600 IN RRSIG DNSKEY 13 2 3600 (
                20260601000000 20260501000000 19036 genericom.com.
                gLcz1Uj9Q1pM7w6P0n0Z3cZ7fZqg+m5wXyVa4iGZ7uFjK9Y2tT0xYn8m
                3xqj8FJK8XpW5lMq3sR2bqgWkJzXVA== )

;; Query time: 12 msec
;; SERVER: 1.1.1.1#53(1.1.1.1) (UDP)
;; WHEN: Tue May 05 12:34:18 UTC 2026
;; MSG SIZE  rcvd: 384

--- what we are seeing ---

flags: qr rd ra **ad**
  └── the `ad` flag (Authenticated Data) confirms that the upstream
      validating resolver verified the DNSSEC chain of trust from the
      root zone down to genericom.com. Without `ad`, the records would
      have been served but their authenticity would be unverified.

ANSWER SECTION contains:
  - DNSKEY 256 (ZSK, key id 28734) — Zone Signing Key
  - DNSKEY 257 (KSK, key id 19036) — Key Signing Key (the trust anchor
      that the parent .com zone has a DS record for)
  - RRSIG over DNSKEY signed by KSK 19036, valid through 2026-06-01
  └── the presence of an RRSIG covering the DNSKEY RRset, signed by
      the KSK referenced in the parent zone's DS record, completes
      the chain. Resolvers can independently cryptographically
      verify that these DNSKEYs are the authentic ones for this zone.

Result: DNSSEC is enabled, configured correctly, and verifying end-to-end.
